comparison.objective: Rack-rail installation versus controlled closing of a stayed tool-chest lid.
comparison.physical_skill: Rail orientation, staged spring-prong insertion, telescoping and screw fastening versus holding a release while safely lowering a hinge.
comparison.success_condition: Persistent four-point rail retention, level rack-unit registration and correct bottom-hole screws versus a shut, still lid with speed and pinch-zone limits.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanisms and outcomes differ; bimanual force control is only a generic shared primitive. Candidate numeric spring-force and damage limits remain unspecified, but that does not obscure the distinction.
